encounter.text: A rat sits cross-legged on an upturned pail, sawing at a fiddle with a bow made of stripped wire. The music echoes strangely in the tunnel — too melancholy for the dripping dark. A battered hat sits in the slick water at their feet, empty. They don't look up.

choices.text: Stop and listen to the whole song.
Tell them to keep it down.

listened.text: The song winds down to a single long note that hangs in the dark and fades. The rat lowers the bow and looks at you at last — small eyes, red-rimmed. 'Thank you,' they say. 'Most don't stop.' Something in you feels lighter than it did.

choices.text: Nod and continue on your way.

offended.text: The music stops. The rat turns to look at you with a stillness that is more unsettling than anger. 'I have been playing this tunnel for eleven years,' they say, very quietly. 'No one tells me to stop.' They stand, bow raised.

items.name: Wire Bow
items.description: A fiddle bow repurposed as a weapon. Stings.
